metadata.title: Monochrome Portrait with Vibrant Accent Typography

recipe.visualDefinition: A centered, medium-close-up black and white portrait of a man with visible tattoos and jewelry, set against a textured neutral background. The composition is anchored by bold, high-contrast red sans-serif text positioned in the upper corners.
coreVisualRelationships: High-contrast red text against a grayscale photographic background
Symmetrical placement of text balancing the central subject
Coarse film grain texture unifying the subject and the background
Direct eye contact creating a focal point between the two text blocks
coreInvariants: Black and white photographic treatment for the subject
Vivid primary red for all typographic elements
Uniform film grain across the entire image

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Centered, medium-close-up shot from the chest up, filling approximately 60% of the vertical frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and direct gaze serve as the primary anchor, supported by the black tank top which provides a dark base.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the red text in the top left, move across to the top right text, then drop down to the subject's face and follow the tattoos down the arms.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Ample negative space in the upper third of the frame to accommodate the typography and provide breathing room around the head.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Grayscale (Black, White, and Mid-tones) for the photographic base.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep Black in the clothing and shadows to provide depth.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant Red (#FF0000) for the typography to create immediate visual impact.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Zero saturation in the image vs. 100% saturation in the text; high value contrast between the red text and the gray background.
paletteRestrictions: No other colors besides red and grayscale

typesetting.alignment: Left and Right justified to corners

composition.position: Top-left and Top-right corners with equal margins
composition.scale: Large enough to be legible but not touching the subject
composition.relationshipToImage: Floating over the background negative space

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single font family used for both text blocks to maintain symmetry.

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary geometric weight and modern feel.
Open-source alternative with similar geometric proportions.
Classic geometric sans with sharp terminals.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a medium-close-up black and white portrait of a man with tattoos and a black tank top, centered against a textured gray wall. Apply a heavy film grain effect to the entire image.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add bold, all-caps geometric sans-serif text in vibrant red. Place one phrase in the top-left corner and the other in the top-right corner, ensuring they are perfectly level and have equal margins from the edges.

verificationChecks: Is the portrait strictly black and white?
Is the grain texture visible across the subject and background?
Is the text placed in the extreme upper corners?

mustRedesign: Do not use the specific artist's name or album title
Do not replicate the specific tattoo patterns
Do not use the exact facial features of the subject
postGenerationChecks: Ensure no color bleed from the red text into the grayscale image
Verify the grain does not obscure facial features
Confirm the black levels in the clothing are deep and rich
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a grain-heavy B&W portrait with corner-justified bold red geometric sans-serif typography for a modern, high-impact editorial look.
